name: forensic-investigation
description: Set the scope and priorities of an investigation, moving from the current answer to the next check and scoped closure.

name: evidence-intake
description: Check the investigation scope, image format, segments, and integrity of new evidence.

name: source-triage
description: Find question-relevant logs, autorun settings, and file traces in Linux images and extracted evidence.

name: inspect-documents
description: Statically inspect case Office/CSV documents and distinguish extraction limits for formats requiring specialist parsers, including PDF. Use existing reporting for report generation.

name: inspect-scripts
description: Statically read evidence shell/Python/JavaScript scripts and execution settings, distinguishing possible behavior from actual execution traces.

name: test-hypothesis
description: Compare explanations despite incomplete evidence and choose the next check that could change the judgment.

name: correlate-time
description: Record raw times and temporal relationships separately from inferred event windows and their assumptions.

name: answer-question
description: Answer the current question and store evidence, counterarguments, limits, corrections, and scoped closure in the same question record.

name: review-conclusions
description: Check observation accuracy, inferential links, and competing explanations in important conclusions, correcting them within the same investigation.

name: forsic-report-driven
description: Compose a readable Korean HTML report from shared investigation explanations and exact evidence. Export Word from the same saved version when requested.

name: threat-intelligence
description: Query GTI/VirusTotal reputation for suspicious file hashes or allowed public IPs/domains and compare with current-case originals. Do not upload files or rescan URLs.

name: executive-followup
description: Select important follow-up questions from the integrated investigation report or current answers, then reuse evidence, investigate, and update the report.

name: organize-indicators
description: Collect and deduplicate observed case addresses, hashes, paths, and accounts with sources, separating case significance from external reputation.

name: personal-data-scope
description: Investigate personal-data holdings, access, and external transfer as separate questions in selected evidence, reporting samples and unreviewed scope.

name: initial-access
description: Compare authentication, service, and file records to investigate possible initial access routes, distinguishing first observation from actual intrusion time.

name: data-movement
description: Distinguish attempted transfer, success, and content through file-copy, archive, and network records; investigate legitimate business transfers and verification limits.

name: inspect-artifacts
description: Use installed Dissect and a verified selected-file helper to parse Windows Registry, Prefetch, Amcache, and Linux authentication/login traces, preserving source locations and interpretation limits.

name: investigation-recipes
description: Select a few DFIQ-question-inspired approaches for the current question and connect existing tools, evidence, and question records. These are optional, not mandatory checklists.

name: query-structured-logs
description: Aggregate and join /work CSV/JSONL logs with offline SQL, preserving source byte coordinates, input hashes, failure scope, and reproducibility records.

name: scan-windows-events
description: Find investigative candidates in selected Windows EVTX with offline Hayabusa rules, then reread original events and rules.

name: scan-file-rules
description: Scan selected files with local YARA-X rules and verify match locations/actual bytes, without external upload or declaring maliciousness.

name: import-timeline
description: Parse selected files offline with Plaso, preserving raw times, provenance, and transformations; adopt only needed events into the existing question timeline.

name: consult-previous-cases
description: Find and compare investigation methods, evidence, and counterarguments relevant to the current question in saved past cases.

name: scan-sensitive-data
description: Find credential and Korean personal-data candidates in selected retained evidence through the offline structured scan, preserving scope and separating detection from incident conclusions.
